faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Clear answers to help you make informed decisions before starting
faq.q1: How long does a typical project take?
faq.a1: Timelines depend on scope and complexity. Marketing websites typically take 1-2 weeks, while custom digital systems or AI agent solutions take 3-6 weeks with continuous progress updates.
faq.q2: What technology stack do you work with?
faq.a2: We use modern standards including Next.js (React), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and reliable cloud infrastructures like Firebase to guarantee high security, speed, and effortless scaling.
faq.q3: Can I update website content myself after delivery?
faq.a3: Yes, absolutely! The platform includes an intuitive CMS admin panel where you can add, edit, or remove projects and content without touching a line of code.
faq.q4: Do you provide post-launch support and warranty?
faq.a4: Yes, all projects include complimentary post-launch support and warranty, with flexible ongoing maintenance plans available as your business grows.
